versions.changelog:
- Initial release of varexis-index-discovery skill.
- Enables finding and previewing public VAREXIS-INDEX evidence, and explains Tool Admission and Audit Coverage features, prices, and limitations.
- Does not run checkers or handle user declarations, payments, or private data.
- Guides users to public evidence and checker documentation using only read-only, public endpoints—no installation or authentication needed.
- Clearly details licence terms and exclusions; does not include checker executables or perform enforcement.
